  s.received_time as "ReceivedDateTime",
  dr.issued as "AuthorisedDateTime",
  lr.analysis_at as "AnalysisDateTime",
  lr.rejection_code as "LIMSRejectionCode",
  lr.rejection_reason as "LIMSRejectionDesc",
  case when coalesce(preg.text_value, coalesce(preg.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || preg.numeric_value::text, preg.coded_value) is null then 'Unreported' else coalesce(preg.text_value, coalesce(preg.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || preg.numeric_value::text, preg.coded_value) end as "Pregnant",

  ax.target_time_days as "TargetTimeDays",
  ax.target_time_mins as "TargetTimeMins",
  ax.repeated as "Repeated",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tl where tl.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:link-sites' and tl.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaLink",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tp where tp.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:poc-sites' and tp.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaPoc"
from lab_requests lr
left join diagnostic_reports dr on dr.based_on_id = lr.id
left join specimens s on s.id = dr.specimen_id
left join patients p on p.id = lr.patient_id
left join attrs ax on ax.lab_request_id = lr.id
left join facility_map fmr on fmr.source_system = coalesce(lr.source_system, '') and fmr.performer_system = coalesce(lr.requester_system, '') and fmr.source_code = lr.requester_code
left join facility_map fml on fml.source_system = coalesce(dr.source_system, '') and fml.performer_system = coalesce(dr.performer_system, '') and fml.source_code = dr.performer
left join lab_results preg on preg.request_id = lr.id and preg.observation_code = 'ENCON'
left join lab_results bf on bf.request_id = lr.id and bf.observation_code = 'AMAME'
left join lab_results ft on ft.request_id = lr.id and ft.observation_code = 'VIRAP'
left join lab_results cday on cday.request_id = lr.id and cday.observation_code = 'LABDA'
left join lab_results ctime on ctime.request_id = lr.id and ctime.observation_code = 'LABHO'
left join lab_results tarvd on tarvd.request_id = lr.id and tarvd.observation_code = 'TARVD'
left join lab_results tarvp on tarvp.request_id = lr.id and tarvp.observation_code = 'TARVP'
left join lab_results tarvs on tarvs.request_id = lr.id and tarvs.observation_code = 'TARVS'
left join lab_results motivo on motivo.request_id = lr.id and motivo.observation_code = 'ESCOL'
left join lab_results tarvq on tarvq.request_id = lr.id and tarvq.observation_code = 'TARVQ'
left join lab_results labti on labti.request_id = lr.id and labti.observation_code = 'LABTI'
left join lab_results virad on virad.request_id = lr.id and virad.observation_code = 'VIRAD'
left join lab_results virr1 on virr1.request_id = lr.id and virr1.observation_code = 'VIRR1'
left join lab_results labno on labno.request_id = lr.id and labno.observation_code = 'LABNO'
left join lab_results conse on conse.request_id = lr.id and conse.observation_code = 'CONSE'
left join lab_results lablo on lablo.request_id = lr.id and lablo.observation_code = 'LABLO'
where lr.panel_code = 'VIRAL'
  and lr.authored_at >= {{param.from}}
  and lr.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
  and ({{param.facility}} = '' or lr.requester_code = {{param.facility}})
order by lr.authored_at, lr.id

  s.type_code as "LIMSSpecimenSourceCode",
  s.type_text as "LIMSSpecimenSourceDesc",
  ax.hl7_specimen_site as "HL7SpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_code as "LIMSSpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_desc as "LIMSSpecimenSiteDesc",
  ax.work_units as "WorkUnits",
  ax.cost_units as "CostUnits",
  dr.section_code as "HL7SectionCode",
  dr.status as "HL7ResultStatusCode",
  lr.registered_by as "RegisteredBy",
  lr.tested_by as "TestedBy",
  dr.authorised_by as "AuthorisedBy",
  ax.ordering_notes as "OrderingNotes",
  ax.encrypted_patient_id as "EncryptedPatientID",
  ax.ethnic_group as "HL7EthnicGroupCode",
  ax.deceased as "Deceased",
  ax.newborn as "Newborn",
  ax.patient_class as "HL7PatientClassCode",
  lr.requester_practitioner as "AttendingDoctor",
  ax.referring_request_id as "ReferringRequestID",
  ax.therapy as "Therapy",
  lr.analyzer_code as "LIMSAnalyzerCode",
  ax.target_time_days as "TargetTimeDays",
  ax.target_time_mins as "TargetTimeMins",
  ax.repeated as "Repeated",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tl where tl.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:link-sites' and tl.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaLink",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tp where tp.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:poc-sites' and tp.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaPoc"
from lab_requests lr
left join diagnostic_reports dr on dr.based_on_id = lr.id
left join specimens s on s.id = dr.specimen_id
left join patients p on p.id = lr.patient_id
left join attrs ax on ax.lab_request_id = lr.id
left join facility_map fmr on fmr.source_system = coalesce(lr.source_system, '') and fmr.performer_system = coalesce(lr.requester_system, '') and fmr.source_code = lr.requester_code
left join facility_map fml on fml.source_system = coalesce(dr.source_system, '') and fml.performer_system = coalesce(dr.performer_system, '') and fml.source_code = dr.performer
left join lab_results hivvd on hivvd.request_id = lr.id and hivvd.observation_code = 'HIVVD'
left join lab_results hivvr on hivvr.request_id = lr.id and hivvr.observation_code = 'HIVVR'
left join lab_results hivvc on hivvc.request_id = lr.id and hivvc.observation_code = 'HIVVC'
left join lab_results hivvf on hivvf.request_id = lr.id and hivvf.observation_code = 'HIVVF'
left join lab_results hivrl on hivrl.request_id = lr.id and hivrl.observation_code = 'HIVRL'
where lr.panel_code = 'HIVVL'
  and lr.authored_at >= {{param.from}}
  and lr.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
  and ({{param.facility}} = '' or lr.requester_code = {{param.facility}})
order by lr.authored_at, lr.id
